title: Construct mixed cross-side idles and prove two budget obstructions (no new κ)
body:
Two mixed left/right idle lines cross the three-query bridge of the pinned #6833 9|9 word after enlarging its stage masks. Exact query annihilation, an arbitrary-input normalized stage identity and integral native interface bases establish actual transport. Its complete invoice is strictly worse than the source for every power tariff r^t, 0<t<1.

An interval pairing-capacity relaxation also excludes nonnegative gain from any fixed, mutually dual-orthogonal interval-idle schedule on either declared mask at C=0.0033718004755. Even granting fractional jobs and incompatible carrier choices, the complete signed-moment gain is below -36.7785606995 for (1,2) and -68.1289200947 for (4,4). All eighteen native bills, helper credits, twenty main targets, three thin queries and idle dimensions are included. These are fixed-C bounds, not an all-later-C ceiling.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6833: 51f54e3c31f2f3a3e056a483b3ed66ae916ad06a.
Native #6824: 2a7ca44fbda3abaa4df355b183ed7d7478eef7c1, retained via #6835 at 44316f3e6023a7f8c516360e22e9efd6f0fe48c5. Exact paths and byte pins are retained.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonchain-root-transport
```
Expected: PASS_INDEPENDENT_MIXED_TRANSPORT_AUDIT and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: primary normal/-O replay and a separate implementation with no model or predecessor imports. All 513 interval capacities (342 changed-mask intervals plus 171 source intervals) agree with explicit primal/dual pairing ranks; independent rational enclosures check all 342 dual inequalities. Literal whole-idle execution passes at both signs, eighteen prime stage multipliers and all twenty columns. The native census is independently recounted. Controls reject broken transport, an omitted idle, inflated dual and false nullspace-capacity shortcut. Deterministic domain: two declared mask systems, all 171 intervals each; no random seed. Committed bytes/modes, export integrity and all three fresh Git-free exported replays pass. Complete remote tree matches tested contents.

No new κ. Changed masks lie outside the #6836/#6839/#6840 contracts; #6842 studies header classification and support arcs without pricing. Arbitrary masks, non-shortest roots, stage-dependent carriers and different factorizations remain open. All five framework assumptions remain; no complete supplier/compiler admission or source-history ancestry pass is claimed.
